div.ab: LXXXVIII. Gif mon þonne aceorfe an treow, ðæt mæge XXX swina undergestondon, ⁊ wyrð undirne, gesylle LX scll'.
LXXXVIII. Gif mon þonne aceorfe an treow, þæt mæge XXX swina undergestandan, ⁊ wyrð undierne, geselle LX scill.
Si quis lignum unum truncabit, sub quo XXX porci stare possent, et compareat, triginta sol. emendet (ad witam).
{LXXXVIII} Gif mon þonne aceorfe an treow, þæt mæge XXX swina undergestandan, ⁊ wyrð undierne, geselle LX sciƚƚ.
If, however, a man cuts down a tree under which thirty swine may stand and it becomes known, let him pay 60 shillings.
If, however, anyone cuts down a tree that can shelter thirty swine, and it becomes known, he shall pay 60 shillings.
If, however, anyone cuts down a tree under which 30 swine could stand, and it becomes known, he is to pay 60 shillings.
Wenn jemand jedoch [auch nur] einen Baum abhaut, unter welchem 30 Schweine stehen können, und [es] wird kund, so zahle er [je] 60 Schill.
But if someone cuts down [even only] one tree under which 30 pigs can stand, and [it] becomes known, let him pay [for each] 60 shillings.
